component.name: Nexus Open
component.summary: Show the time, your computer and your music on the iCUE Nexus strip

description.p: Nexus Open is an open source app for the Corsair iCUE Nexus; not made or endorsed by Corsair. The Nexus is the small touch screen that sits above a keyboard.
It shows the time, temperatures and load, the weather and what is playing, and puts media, volume and launchers under your finger. Swipe along the strip to change page.
A small service draws the strip as soon as you log in. The settings window shows a live preview: arrange the pages and widgets there, and every change appears on the strip at once.
There is no account and no cloud service, and it needs no root once installed.
The first release of the rebuilt app.
